thesis: IDXX is a quality name, but this is a poor moment to add. The stock is up about 26% in 21 days on a gap whose cause the news card could not source, and it now trades at a rich multiple with the mean analyst target roughly at spot, so consensus offers no upside. The regime is risk-off with high confidence. Reward/risk of 1.75 is modest, and the setup needs volume confirmation that current light volume does not give. Today is a thin half-day session, and the next catalyst (earnings) is outside the holding window. That leaves nothing to support the rerating while the market drags. Even defensive health-care strength does not rescue a stretched, crowded-by-ETF-flow tape.
